facts.text: Under the North Star Promise, eligible Minnesota residents with a family adjusted gross income below $80,000 receive full coverage of remaining tuition after other scholarships and grants are applied.

sources.title: Grants and waivers | Duluth One Stop Student Services
sources.quote: Minnesota resident students with a family adjusted gross income below $80,000, as determined by the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA), may be eligible for the North Star Promise Scholarship.

sources.title: Grants and waivers | Duluth One Stop Student Services
sources.quote: North Star Promise covers the remaining balance of resident tuition each term, including summer if funding is available, after other scholarships, grants, stipends, and tuition waivers are applied to your student account.
